question: How do the phoneme groups abide and emanate from Anuttara?
premises: The principles from Anuttara onward abide from ka to sa.
inference: The phonemic spectrum from ka to sa abides in Anuttara and emerges first as the fivefold ka-group.
plain_english: In the same way, those beginning with Anuttara abide as the range from ka to sa. From Anuttara comes the clear emanation of the fivefold ka-group.
